name: Push-Up
instructions: Start in high plank. Lower chest to floor, push up. Keep core tight.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from bar, palms facing away. Pull until chin clears bar. Lower with control.

name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand feet shoulder-width. Lower hips back and down until thighs parallel. Drive through heels.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on bench, dumbbells at chest. Press up and slightly together. Lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Row
instructions: Brace one knee on bench, hinge forward. Row dumbbell to hip, elbow back. Lower slow.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold weight in front. Hinge at hips, pushing them back. Lower bar along legs, feel hamstring stretch. Drive hips forward.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit or stand, dumbbells at ear level. Press overhead until arms almost straight. Lower with control.

name: Lateral Raise
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides. Raise arms to shoulder height, slight elbow bend. Lower slow.

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Bar on upper traps. Feet shoulder-width+. Squat below parallel. Drive up through heels.

name: Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Feet hip-width, bar over mid-foot. Hinge, grip bar. Brace, drive floor away, lock hips at top.

name: Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Stand, dumbbells at sides. Curl toward shoulders, squeeze biceps. Lower with control.

name: Tricep Dip
instructions: Hands on parallel bars. Lower body until upper arms parallel. Push up to start.

name: Plank
instructions: Forearms and toes on floor, body straight. Hold. Do not let hips sag or rise.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from bar. Raise straight legs to 90 degrees. Lower with control, no swinging.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Rear foot elevated on bench. Lower front knee toward floor. Keep torso upright. Drive through front heel.

name: Cable Chest Fly
instructions: Set cables at shoulder height. Grab handles, step forward. Bring hands together in arc, slight elbow bend.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Set cable/band at head height. Pull toward face, elbows flared. Squeeze rear delts at end.

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Hinge at hips, swing kettlebell back. Drive hips forward, swing to chest height. Control on the way back.

name: Resistance Band Row
instructions: Anchor band at chest level. Pull toward torso, squeezing shoulder blades. Control release.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on back, knees bent. Drive hips to ceiling, squeeze glutes at top. Lower slow.

name: Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on edge of step. Rise onto toes, full stretch at bottom. Control the movement.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set bench 30-45 degrees. Press dumbbells up from chest. Keep wrists stacked over elbows.

name: Bent Over Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge to 45-70 degrees. Pull bar to lower chest/upper abdomen. Squeeze lats. Lower controlled.

name: Machine Leg Press
instructions: Seat close, feet shoulder-width on plate. Lower until 90 degrees. Press up, don't lock knees.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Grip bar wide. Pull to upper chest, arch slightly. Squeeze lats. Control upward.

name: Skullcrusher
instructions: Lie on bench, bar above forehead. Lower toward forehead by bending elbows. Extend back up.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Hold dumbbells, palms facing each other. Curl up without rotating. Lower controlled.

name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Upper back on bench, bar on hips. Drive hips up to full extension. Squeeze glutes at top.

name: Running
instructions: Run at a comfortable pace. Maintain good posture, relaxed arms. Land mid-foot.

name: Burpee
instructions: Squat, jump feet back to plank, push-up, jump feet in, jump up with arms overhead.

name: Mountain Climber
instructions: High plank. Drive one knee to chest, alternate legs rapidly. Keep hips level.

name: Jumping Jack
instructions: Jump feet apart while raising arms overhead. Return. Keep a steady rhythm.

name: Box Jump
instructions: Stand in front of box. Swing arms, bend knees, explode up. Land softly, step down.

name: Dumbbell Lunge
instructions: Stand with dumbbells. Step forward, lower knee near floor. Push back to start. Alternate legs.

name: Cable Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Stand at cable, bar at chest height. Push bar down until arms straight. Control upward.
